mixture_lift.law: Let nu_N be any probability law on real T3 trigonometric polynomials supported in |k|_2<=N; write H_N for fixed-ratio shell mass of sgn(f_N) and delta_N=int(f_N^2-1)^2
mixture_lift.pointwise_input: On {H_N>=eta/2}, K1549 gives delta_N>=c_(alpha,eta)N^(-4/3) with a constant independent of the sampled texture
mixture_lift.expected_conclusion: Therefore E_nu delta_N>=c'_(alpha,eta)N^(-4/3) for every law with nonvanishing expected fixed-ratio sign-shell mass
mixture_lift.wick_scale: After amplitude scaling h_N=sqrt(3C_N)f_N, E_nu W_N=9C_N^2 E_nu delta_N=Omega_(alpha,eta)(N^(8/3)) when C_N=Theta(N^2)
mixture_lift.fejer_boundary: K1550 shows why expected sign change is insufficient: a law supported on translated localized Fejer bubbles can be nonconstant while both expected shell mass and defect vanish at order N^(-3)
mixture_lift.scope_guard: The lift is distribution-free after the pointwise theorem but still requires expected fixed-ratio shell mass; it is an interaction lower bound, not a Fisher/capacity computation or a claim about arbitrary nonconstant-sign laws
